Identify potential personal information in a dataset

Source: R/deidentify.R
identify_pii.Rd

Scans column names against a pattern library and inspects values for telephone-like and coordinate-like content. The result is a starting point for human review, not a guarantee: free-text fields can hold names that no automated scan will catch, so read them before release.

identify_pii(x, dictionary = NULL, extra_patterns = NULL)

Arguments

x

A vcs_data object, or a data frame.

dictionary

An optional vcs_dictionary(). Concepts known to be direct identifiers (child_name, caregiver_name, telephone, address, gps_lat, gps_lon) are reported with certainty rather than by pattern.

extra_patterns

Named character vector of additional regular expressions to match against column names.

Value

A tibble with columns variable, category, basis, confidence and n_nonmissing.

See also

deidentify_vcs(), assess_reidentification_risk()

Examples

identify_pii(vcs_example_raw, vcs_example_dictionary)
#> # A tibble: 48 × 5
#>    variable       category  basis                        confidence n_nonmissing
#>    <chr>          <chr>     <chr>                        <chr>             <int>
#>  1 CG_NAME_1_1    name      "dictionary concept \"careg… certain             214
#>  2 CG_NAME_1_2    name      "dictionary concept \"careg… certain              42
#>  3 CG_NAME_2_1    name      "dictionary concept \"careg… certain               0
#>  4 CG_NAME_2_2    name      "dictionary concept \"careg… certain               0
#>  5 CVH01_date_1_1 telephone "values look like phone num… likely              116
#>  6 CVH01_date_1_2 telephone "values look like phone num… likely               15
